controls_retained: Q_INFORMED_WOR_DISTINCT remains an unchanged v1 sensitivity arm
Q_DELETE, MATCH_EXPOSURE and JACCARD allocation rows remain explicit controls on the same selected-identity surface
EXACT_K4_FULL remains the v1 capital-normalized economic reference and is not resampled

frozen_arm.coverage: Every non-FULL Gate-A v1 row, with identical complete-issue identities, gate, K, M, selected portfolio IDs, allocation status, and seed set.
frozen_arm.definition: For each selected identity and frozen seed, M independent Q-weighted draws are made with replacement over its 3^7 ticket space. Every draw is a separate ¥2 ticket. Exact duplicate code vectors are retained as separate paid stakes and separate individual tax units.

outcome_boundary: No test outcome, score, final/winning SP, settlement, payout, ROI, tax realization, or post-kickoff input is read or emitted.
scope: historical paper research only; no purchase, production, betting, or promotion authority.
